name: Wakō (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Wakō city emblem in white: a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised letter W.
history: Municipal flag of Wakō, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 31 October 1970.

features.role: Wakō city emblem — a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised letter W
